TC-16/S18.title: Wrong device date (3.8), seeded: a phone one day ahead records a line between two writes from a correct device
TC-16/S18.detail: New local spec: the three rounding.update writes the two clients send (device A today [A1, A2]; device B, clock a day ahead, tomorrow [B1]; device A today [A1, A2, A3]), then the Encounter tab on a correctly clocked browser. FAIL, 0/3, exactly as the code reading predicted: the panel shows 'Oct 14 (prior) 2 lines', 'Oct 15 (prior) 1 lines' (tomorrow) and 'Most Recent 3 lines'; A1 and A2 are listed twice; B1 is kept. UAT 3.8 asks for one session with each line once and no row dated tomorrow.
TC-16/S18.productIssue: A phone whose clock is a day ahead files its bedside line in a row dated tomorrow, on the shared record every device sees; the next write from a correctly clocked device then archives that row and lists the lines recorded before it twice. The transcript archive trusts the device date (useEncounterCapture.ts transcriptDate = device toDateString; transcriptArchive.ts). Breaks UAT 3.8 (server time; one device set to the wrong date shows the same state) and U11 (no line listed twice).
